title: Agent-Specific Deontic Modality Detection in Legal Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on "deontic modality" within legal contracts, specifically identifying obligations, entitlements, prohibitions, and permissions of contracting parties. While deontic logic has philosophical roots, the application here is strictly for legal interpretation of contractual rights and duties, not for evaluating or benchmarking general moral, ethical, or religious reasoning. The 'Ethical Considerations' section addresses the responsible use of the technology itself, not the core content of faith or ethics.
